ui_copy.ui.title: SIX MONTHS OF PROMISES
ui_copy.ui.subtitle: Choose what Minjun protects — and what he must let go.
ui_copy.ui.home.title: Six months. One promise you refuse to drop.
ui_copy.ui.home.body: Each month, choose one protected promise. If last month left margin on the same axis, you may carry one more alongside it. Everything else reaches its stated consequence.
ui_copy.ui.home.restart_confirm: PRESS AGAIN TO ERASE THIS PLAYTEST SAVE
ui_copy.ui.home.autosave: Only this six-month playtest is saved. Retail and 24-week saves are never opened.
ui_copy.ui.month.prompt: What will you protect this month?
ui_copy.ui.month.margin.none: No margin carried · choose one protected promise
ui_copy.ui.month.margin.available: {axis} margin available · one {axis_lower} promise may be added
ui_copy.ui.detail.empty: Move focus to a promise to inspect it.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_same_card: The same promise cannot fill both roles.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_no_margin: No carried margin is available this month.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_spends: Adding it spends this month's {axis_lower} margin. It is not refunded.
ui_copy.ui.detail.single_margin: Keeping only this protected promise can create {axis_lower} margin next month.
ui_copy.ui.detail.repay_pressure: Keeping it repays pressure carried from last month. It creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.repay_deferred: Keeping it repays a promise deferred from last month. It creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.double_no_margin: Keeping two promises spends the carried margin and creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.deferred_once: If missed, it returns once next month. Missing it again closes that door.
ui_copy.ui.detail.expired: If missed, this specific door or pressure takes effect now.
ui_copy.ui.controls: ARROWS / D-PAD · MOVE    ENTER / SOUTH · CONFIRM    ESC / EAST · UNDO
ui_copy.ui.status.primary_set: Protected promise set. You may now inspect an eligible second promise.
ui_copy.ui.status.optional_set: Alongside promise set. The carried margin will be spent on confirmation.
ui_copy.ui.status.optional_removed: Alongside promise removed. The margin is still available until confirmation.
ui_copy.ui.status.primary_removed: Protected promise removed. Alongside was cleared with it.
ui_copy.ui.status.invalid: That role is not available for this promise.
ui_copy.ui.result.title: What you kept — and what moved on without you
ui_copy.ui.result.margin.run_complete: Six-month sample complete · {axis} margin is recorded, but there is no playable next month in this sample.
ui_copy.ui.recap.title: Six months of choices
ui_copy.ui.recap.body: This is not a score. It is the route made by what you protected, what margin let you carry, and which doors you allowed to close.

contract.pressure: 500,000 won in cash and surviving the first month
contract.opportunity: The first application and an entry into legitimate work
contract.person_promise: Do not turn Dad's and Hyunsu's arrival into schedule filler
contract.deadline: The borrowed-account offer in W4 can only be answered this month

M02.design_label: The Face of the First Choice

contract.pressure: The result of the first choice and the cost of staying afloat
contract.opportunity: A second attempt to reach out to Hyunsu first
contract.person_promise: Do not bury rejection and acceptance under the same sentence
contract.deadline: The world event in W8 returns only once before month-end

contract.pressure: Finding time to seek people out while earning money
contract.opportunity: The first real crossing with Daeun or Jiyeon
contract.person_promise: After a chance meeting, progress opens only when the player spends time
contract.deadline: The first meeting can happen only along this month's route through the city

contract.pressure: Rent and a job result arrive at the same time
contract.opportunity: Sangchul's first coffee and a door to money
contract.person_promise: Sangchul must not look like a villain at the first meeting
contract.deadline: The first meeting opens only on the actual room-viewing route

contract.pressure: A work decision and someone met earlier demand the same time
contract.opportunity: An ordinary reunion with Jaehyuk or a second crossing with an existing connection
contract.person_promise: Jaehyuk is not offering an investment or guarantee yet
contract.deadline: Anyone not sought out again this month leaves a cost to re-enter

contract.pressure: Work, people, and family deadlines collide on one Friday
contract.person_promise: Even unchosen promises retain their source and expiry
contract.deadline: After Friday of W24, none of these deadlines can move to next week

m01_survival_shift.label: Finish enough shifts to cover the first month's rent and food.
m01_survival_shift.completed_preview: Secure this month's survival floor and prepare a cash choice for next month.
m01_survival_shift.missed_preview: A cash gap for next month's rent and food remains as pressure.

m01_legal_application.label: Submit the first legitimate application and finish preparing for the interview.
m01_legal_application.completed_preview: Open the hiring result in M04 and a path into legitimate work.
m01_legal_application.missed_preview: This posting and its hiring-result window close.

m01_father_call.label: Call Dad first and ask how he is this week.
m01_father_call.completed_preview: Keep the early family contact and prepare a trust choice for next month.
m01_father_call.missed_preview: It returns once in M02 as a call-back debt; miss it again and the early contact cools.

m02_close_account_risk.label: Check and contain the account risk and cash gap left by the first illegal offer.
m02_close_account_risk.completed_preview: Seal the account risk. If this month repays the prior cash gap, it creates no new margin.
m02_close_account_risk.missed_preview: A financial scar and cash pressure remain for next month.

m02_hyunsu_first_promise.label: Show up for the first study promise made with Hyunsu and hold your place beside him.
m02_hyunsu_first_promise.completed_preview: Open the first shared-study path with Hyunsu, one not built on money.
m02_hyunsu_first_promise.missed_preview: Hyunsu's early path closes; only a later reunion remains.

m02_return_father_call.label: Call Dad back the same day after his short message.
m02_return_father_call.completed_preview: Repay last month's call-back debt, but create no new margin from it.
m02_return_father_call.missed_preview: Missing him a second time lets the early family contact go cold.

m03_cover_deposit_gap.label: Confirm the deposit shortfall and remaining lodging days before notice to leave.
m03_cover_deposit_gap.completed_preview: Secure a housing floor. If this repairs last month's financial scar, it creates no new margin.
m03_cover_deposit_gap.missed_preview: Emergency lodging and more expensive housing pressure arrive in M04.

m03_daeun_return.label: Return to the convenience store at dawn and ask Daeun her name.
m03_daeun_return.completed_preview: Open Daeun's immediate entry scene and the relationship path that follows.
m03_daeun_return.missed_preview: Daeun's immediate entry door closes this time.

m03_jiyeon_answer.label: Answer Jiyeon's offer to compensate you after the bicycle accident.
m03_jiyeon_answer.completed_preview: Open Jiyeon's immediate entry scene and the relationship path that follows.
m03_jiyeon_answer.missed_preview: This window to answer Jiyeon directly closes.

m04_answer_job_result.label: Answer the hiring result and confirm the first day of work.
m04_answer_job_result.completed_preview: Confirm the first legitimate workday and a stable-income path.
m04_answer_job_result.missed_preview: This hiring result and first-day window close.

m04_independent_room_view.label: Visit one room you booked yourself and check the deposit and monthly rent.
m04_independent_room_view.completed_preview: Get an independent housing quote. If this repairs last month's housing pressure, it creates no new margin.
m04_independent_room_view.missed_preview: The booked listing and its quote window close.

m04_sangchul_office_coffee.label: Ask Sangchul the real room price in his office and stay until the coffee cools.
m04_sangchul_office_coffee.completed_preview: Open the warmer early path where Sangchul is a person before he is a deal.
m04_sangchul_office_coffee.missed_preview: The warm first meeting closes; his M06 contact comes only as a cold field deal.

m05_job_result.label: Settle one next step for your current livelihood: start date, shift, or another application.
m05_job_result.completed_preview: Confirm a current livelihood line that does not duplicate the M04 hiring result.
m05_job_result.missed_preview: The current livelihood line breaks, making the cash choice in M06 more urgent.

m05_jaehyuk_reunion.label: Keep the street-stall reunion with Jaehyuk where money is not discussed.
m05_jaehyuk_reunion.completed_preview: Preserve the plain friendship with Jaehyuk from before money entered it.
m05_jaehyuk_reunion.missed_preview: The ordinary reunion closes; a later meeting will sit closer to a transaction.

m05_second_crossing.label: Contact the person you protected in M03 and arrange a second meeting.

label_by_actor.daeun: Contact Daeun first and arrange a second meeting.
label_by_actor.jiyeon: Contact Jiyeon first and arrange a second meeting.

m05_second_crossing.completed_preview: Make an M06 date with the person protected in M03 and advance that relationship.
m05_second_crossing.missed_preview: The M06 date with that same person returns once as a relationship debt.

m06_work_deadline.label: Submit the hiring or livelihood deadline paperwork yourself before 6:30 p.m. Friday.
m06_work_deadline.completed_preview: Meet this work deadline, first repairing any livelihood break carried from last month.
m06_work_deadline.missed_preview: The current legitimate-work door and the next income opportunity close.

m06_sangchul_door.label: Check the field address from Sangchul's side and arrive there that same Friday.
m06_sangchul_door.completed_preview: Answer this money and field offer, whether or not the earlier connection was warm.
m06_sangchul_door.missed_preview: This field invitation and the introducer's door close.

m06_family_signal.label: Call Dad at the agreed time after the pharmacy-bag signal.
m06_family_signal.completed_preview: Hear Dad's health warning in time and open a path to family care.
m06_family_signal.missed_preview: Lose the right to know in time and this family-health window.

m06_person_date.label: Go on the Friday date with the same person recorded in the M05 promise.

label_by_actor.daeun: Go on the Friday date promised with Daeun in M05.
label_by_actor.jiyeon: Go on the Friday date promised with Jiyeon in M05.

m06_person_date.completed_preview: Keep the date with the person chosen in M05 and establish the early relationship stage.
m06_person_date.missed_preview: This date and the early relationship stage with that person close.
